channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Parliament speaker says peace bid enters 'riskiest phase'
item.description: Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş has said Türkiye's latest peace initiative has entered its "most risky phase" following PKK’s decision to lay down its arms, warning that the process must move forward without delays.

item.title: 110 smuggled artifacts returned to Türkiye this year
item.description: Türkiye has recovered 110 smuggled artifacts this year, bringing the total number of cultural properties returned since 1980 to 26,761

item.title: Anıtlı’s ‘Best Tourism Village’ title expected to lift visitor numbers
item.description: Anıtlı, a small Syriac heritage settlement about 30 kilometers from the southern province of Mardin’s Midyat and named one of the U.N. World Tourism Organization’s “Best Tourism Villages 2025,” is now positioned to become one of the area’s key drivers of tourism growth.

item.title: Exports climb 2.2 percent to $22.7 billion in November
item.description: Türkiye's exports amounted to $22.7 billion in November, rising 2.2 percent year-on-year despite a negative calendar effect, the Turkish trade minister announced on Dec. 4.

item.title: Ankara renews Russia gas contracts for one year, minister says
item.description: Türkiye has extended two expiring natural gas import deals with Russia for another year, covering a combined 22 billion cubic meters, as it steps up efforts to diversify supplies and considers entering U.S. gas production, Turkish Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said.

item.title: Trump says Putin wants to end war, US to hold new talks with Ukraine
item.description: President Donald Trump said Wednesday he believes Russia's Vladimir Putin wants to end the Ukraine war despite inconclusive talks in Moscow, as U.S. officials prepared for a follow-up meeting with Kiev's top negotiator.

item.title: Türkiye says taking all necessary measures for Black Sea security
item.description: Türkiye has announced it is taking all necessary diplomatic and security measures to protect maritime safety in the Black Sea following a surge in Ukrainian attacks on commercial tankers carrying Russian oil to global markets.

item.title: Erdoğan announces second action plan for people with disabilities
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Dec. 4 that his government is drafting a second comprehensive action plan aimed at improving conditions for people with disabilities.

item.title: Israel awaits return of last hostage remains from Gaza
item.description: Israel awaited the return of the last hostage remains held by Palestinian militants in Gaza, as the military said on Dec. 4 that those of a Thai national had been identified after they were handed over.

item.title: Ankara slams Greek defense minister for escalating tensions
item.description: Turkish officials have stated that while Türkiye is firmly committed to transforming the Aegean Sea into a zone of peace and stability, it will resolutely neutralize any and all threats — in response to Greek Defense Minister Nikos Dendias’ recent comments on Athens’ plans to deploy missiles on Aegean islands.
